# UX & Backward Compatibility Checklist: Adaptive Metric Cycle Goals

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality, clarity, and completeness for adaptive cycle goal creation and backward compatibility across Progress & Goals.
**Created**: 2026-11-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all three Goal Metric pill options (`Weight (kg)`, `Calories (cal)`, `Reps`) and their default selection rules per exercise explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 Are the contextual sub-rows defined for both weight-based goals (`Reps (RM)` stepper + `1, 3, 5, 10` presets) and calorie/reps-based goals (`Time Window`: `1 min`, `3 min`, `5 min`, `Open`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK003 Are the adaptive `Scale:` increment options specified for all three goal metrics (`+2.5%, +5%, +10%` for Weight; `+5, +10, +20 cal` for Calories; `+2, +5, +10 reps` for Reps)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK004 Is the rounding behavior for percentage-based weight scaling vs. additive calorie/rep scaling unambiguously defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK005 Are the historical auto-fill data sources specified for each metric (`RepMax` for Weight; all-time best logged working set for Calories and Reps)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK006 Is the label formatting for `CycleCard` chips and `CycleGoalsProgress` cards explicitly specified across all three metrics and time windows? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Contract §2, §3]

## Backward Compatibility & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK007 Are backward-compatibility requirements defined for legacy `CycleGoal` records lacking explicit metric or time-window metadata? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK008 Does the specification guarantee that reopening an existing cycle preserves stored Start and Target values without overwriting them with auto-fill? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK009 Are requirements defined when a selected movement has no prior RM or logged session history (`Start`/`Target` cleared, `Scale:` chips disabled)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK010 Are backward-compatibility expectations explicitly stated for `Progress & Goals` → `By exercise` and `By routine` views? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 3, §FR-010]

- All 10 requirement-quality criteria (`CHK001`–`CHK010`) verified against `spec.md`, `plan.md`, and `contracts/ui-cycle-goal-card-contract.md`.
